draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.36, the 34th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 3rd of 24 at DT. He went 36th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Javon Hargrave. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2023) ranked 1st in sacks among the 24 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders (reserve). 33 career games and 13 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: sacks 5.0 (90th percentile), qb hits 9 (80th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 interior lineman who played: 11 pressures against a median of 3, above the norm.
